name: Ghost Legion
posture: Covert strikes, information warfare, deniable assets
summary: Elite clandestine force specializing in surgical disruption of rival infrastructures and psy-ops.

name: Echo Tribunal
summary: Ideological adjudicators who weaponize courts, media, and ritual to cement control.

name: Obsidian Pact
posture: Industrial militarism, resource hoarding, paramilitary guilds
summary: Extraction syndicate controlling shipyards and alloy routes. Trades steel for loyalty.

name: Veil Coven
summary: Esoteric cell merging ritual with tech salvage; volatile but valuable informants.

name: Iron Syndicate
posture: Trade coercion, port blockades, contractor fleets
summary: Cartel of port masters and convoy captains. Prefers contracts over cannon—until cornered.
